knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Section 4 Water clarity: the disc must be readily seen at the pool's deepest point.
Sections 4 and 1: clarity supports depth estimation and detection of submerged users; the pool stays closed until the test passes.
Section 4 lists depth estimation, seeing subsurface hazards and detecting submerged users as purposes of clarity.

practicalCriteria: Carries out the disc test at the deepest point using the correct disc, and states the result aloud.
Records depth, time and lighting, and keeps a failed pool closed in a supplied scenario.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Clarity test record for the assessed pool
Assessor observation of the disc test
stopWorkCriteria: A disc that cannot be seen at the pool's deepest point: keep the pool shut and escalate.
No suitable disc available: do not declare the pool compliant.
